provenance: Wordify's official API-token UI, for the ability names
Wordify MCP tool schemas, for operation semantics and parameters
Authenticated read-only Wordify MCP responses against a real account, for response field names
Unauthenticated HTTP route probes, for path existence

not_obtained.openapi_document: https://console.wordify.com/docs/api.json is behind console authentication and was never read. Nothing in this file is derived from it.

authentication.team_header_note: Carries the bound team for a multi-team account. The team id is an opaque string/ULID and is never treated as an integer.

required_abilities.site_scoping: Not supported. Evidence supports team-scoped authorization only; the plugin binds its own operations to one selected site, which is not the same as the token being restricted to one.

route_probe_evidence.method: Unauthenticated JSON requests. No credential was sent and nothing was mutated.
route_probe_evidence.result: Every route listed above answered HTTP 401 with Wordify's JSON error envelope rather than 404, which is what establishes that the path exists.
route_probe_evidence.recheck_disambiguation: POST /api/v1/sites/{site_id}/domains/recheck answered 401. Other candidate recheck paths answered 404 or 405.

error_envelope.body: error.code = unauthenticated, a human message, and error.request_id

attach_domain.make_primary: always boolean false; not exposed as a caller-controlled parameter
attach_domain.use_www: not sent — the contract states it is only meaningful when make_primary is true

request_bodies.recheck: none; the site is already in the path

behaviour.attach_domain: Creates a parked domain pointer, then asynchronously verifies DNS and provisions a certificate. Rejects wordify.io-style provisioning subdomains. Public TLD, no www prefix, 253 characters maximum.
behaviour.recheck: Synchronous. Performs live DNS queries and can trigger a fresh Let's Encrypt issuance request, which is rate limited per registered domain per week. Never called automatically by this plugin.
behaviour.detachment: No domain detachment or deletion operation is exposed by any surface examined. None is implemented, and mapping deletion tells the operator what to remove by hand.

plugin_position.wordify_status_is_not_success: Wordify's dns_status and ssl_status are reported, never acted on. They do not replace the plugin's Cloudflare state, and they do not settle the signed final-origin probe.
plugin_position.ability_proof: The API exposes no read-only way to enumerate a token's abilities, so a read-only connection test cannot prove sites:manage. That is surfaced at the first attachment as a typed insufficient-ability failure with instructions, never as a retry and never by attempting a mutation to probe permissions.
